subject: Sponsor alignment & procurement strawman for LiberateK
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Erica Salazar <erica.salazar@liberatek.com>, Ben Han <ben.han@liberatek.com>, Ravi Singh <r.singh@liberatek.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Sponsor alignment & procurement strawman for LiberateK

Hi Erica / Ben / Ravi —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick post-call recap and a suggested procurement strawman so your procurement and legal teams have something to react to. High-level themes we heard:

- Primary business outcome: reduce customer support triage time by 45% within 6 months through automated intent classification + suggested responses.
- Main pain: current model is on-prem and brittle; infra ops overhead and slow iteration on prompt tuning.
- Success metrics (mutually agreed): intent classification accuracy >= 92% on your support intents, average time-to-respond improvement >= 40%, and under $0.02 per 1k tokens marginal cost once cached.

Procurement strawman (what we propose for a fast path):
1) 12-month Dedicated plan (reserved capacity) sized for 3 peak concurrent workers — predictable SLA and isolated data tenancy.
2) Initial 3-month pilot (convertible) to validate accuracy and perf with a 30% credit back if SLOs not met.
3) SOC2 attestation + on-prem data routing option for regulated flows.
4) SOW: implementation + model tuning + 2 knowledge-transfer sessions.

Open risks / asks from your side:
- Legal: standard data protection addendum + controls for logs retention.
- Eng: will need a sandbox dataset (PII redacted) and 2 API keys for integration testing.
- Procurement: target procurement cadence and PO timelines so we can align capacity commit dates.

Attachment: LiberateK_SOW_v0.1.pdf — draft strawman SOW and rough pricing bands.

Next steps (proposed):
- Erica / Ben: confirm procurement lead and target PO date by EOW (Apr 9).
- Ravi: drop a sanitized sample of 1000 recent support transcripts to the shared folder by Apr 10.
- Marcus/Laura/Kim: we'll prepare a tailored acceptance criteria appendix and a revised SOW for legal review.

If you prefer a quick follow-up tomorrow to walk through the SOW line by line, happy to do 30 minutes.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

--

Subject: Re: Sponsor alignment & procurement strawman for LiberateK

Kim —

Appreciate the clear recap. A couple quick items from our side:

1) Procurement lead: Ben Han (cc'd) — target PO by May 1 if pricing bands hold.
2) Legal: we'll route the SOW + DPA through our counsel; they typically need a separate data handling exhibit.
3) Sandbox data: Ravi will handle the sanitized transcripts and has asked if you can accept S3 upload or secure SFTP.

Question on the pilot credit: what are the explicit SLOs that trigger the 30% credit? Can you put those in the SOW appendix?

Also, we're sensitive to vendor lock-in — can you outline rollback / data egress steps in the SOW?

Happy to do a 30-min walkthrough Friday at 10am PT if that works.

—Erica
Erica Salazar
CFO, LiberateK
erica.salazar@liberatek.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Erica Salazar <erica.salazar@liberatek.com>, Ben Han <ben.han@liberatek.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor alignment & procurement strawman for LiberateK

Kim / Laura —

Thanks — tracking a few procurement-side items and putting together suggested payment cadence to align to their PO timeline. Notes:

- Proposed commercial: 12-month commitment with 3 monthly ramp credits (month 1-3) and net-30 invoicing.
- Pilot credit SLOs (draft):
  * 92% classification accuracy on holdout test set supplied by customer.
  * API 95th percentile latency < 250ms for <= 2k token requests under pilot load.
  * Deployment availability >= 99.5% during pilot period.
  Failure to meet any of the above during the pilot period -> 30% credit applied to pilot invoices.

- Egress / rollback: we propose an automated export of model outputs and user KV cache within 30 days of contract termination; include a one-time export fee if on-prem orchestration required.

Attaching a lightweight SOW stub I started — please review and I'll iterate: LiberateK_SOW_v0.1.pdf

Marcus Lin
Sales Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

--

Kim / Marcus —

High level: supportive but flagging two leadership-level items before we go deeper:

1) Risk: SOC2 evidence and pen-test schedule — do we have a copy of the most recent SOC2 summary and a pen-test window we can share? This goes to their security council.
2) Credits / SLA language: legal will want explicit definitions for "pilot period" and a formula for credit calculation. Marcus, please make the SLOs numeric and unambiguous in the appendix.

If Ben is targeting May 1 PO, we should have legal engaged by Apr 12. I'll ask for an expedited review if needed.

If we need to offer concessions for an accelerated timeline, prepare two concession scenarios: (A) 10% first-year discount in exchange for a firm 12-month commit, (B) extended support hours instead of price. We'll discuss on the internal standup tomorrow.

- Laura
